newsitem.title: UK: T&N has no comment on asbestos insurance talk.
newsitem.headline: T&N has no comment on asbestos insurance talk.

text.p: British auto components group T&N Plc said on Monday it had no comment to make on newspaper reports and share market speculation that it is close to sealing an insurance deal to cap its legacy of asbestosis liabilities.

T&N has said it would consider striking a deal with specialist underwriters, if they could devise an affordable and effective policy structure, noting that share investors would particularly welcome the end of the uncertainty on asbestos.
An article in yesterday's Sunday Times said an agreement, "could be concluded within the next fortnight".
T&N said it had no comment to make on the report.
"We never comment on market speculation," a company spokeswoman said, adding that on the specific issue of asbestos, "We will say something when we have something to say."

In a flurry of early trading interest, T&N shares spiked up 14-1/2 pence in the first hour after the opening and then steadied up 10-1/2 pence at 144 pence by 0950 GMT in turnover of about 1.7 million shares.

According to market sources, there is a widespread belief, cited in the newspaper article, that an insurance deal removing the threat of hefty asbestos costs could put about 1.0 billion stg back onto T&N's market value, currently nearer 700 million.
